links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of two competing DR AI algorithms versus ophthalmologist reference on same images
links.effect: RetCAD sensitivity 90%, specificity 100%; OphtAI sensitivity 70%, specificity 100% for referable DR, so head-to-head comparison revealed a meaningful difference between vendors.
links.quote: In contrast, the second AI-based algorithm OphtAI version 2.3.4 achieved a sensitivity of 70% and a specificity of 100% for the detection of a referable DR.

links.outcome: Local outpatient clinic performance of DR AI compared with ophthalmologist reference and prior study conditions
links.effect: RetCAD's local sensitivity (90%) and specificity (100%) were consistent with study conditions; OphtAI was less sensitive (70%), missing patients with moderate DR.
links.quote: The AI-based algorithm OphtAI, on the other hand, detected fewer patients with moderate DR, which was reflected in lower sensitivity.

screen.reason: Prospective clinical comparison of two commercial AI algorithms (RetCAD vs OphtAI) for diabetic retinopathy screening in a real outpatient diabetes clinic, but does not test a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
